author_notes: Citation: LIU, Y., TSYVINSKI, A. and WU, X. (2022), Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency. The Journal of Finance, 77: 1133-1177. https://doi.org/10.1111/jofi.13119
Weeks are defined as in Liu, Tsyvinski, and Wu (2022): 52 weeks a year with last week more than 7 days.
Updated through 2022 and data are from coingecko since mid-2020.
